len = int(input())
s = input()

max_length = 0
parenthesis_word_count = 0
inside_parenthesis = False
last_was_letter_flag = False
current_word_length = 0

for c in s:
    if c == '(':
        inside_parenthesis = True
        last_was_letter_flag = False
        current_word_length = 0
    elif c == ')':
        inside_parenthesis = False
        last_was_letter_flag = False
        current_word_length = 0
    elif c.isalpha():
        if inside_parenthesis and not last_was_letter_flag:
            parenthesis_word_count += 1
        elif not inside_parenthesis:
            current_word_length += 1
            if current_word_length > max_length:
                max_length = current_word_length
        last_was_letter_flag = True
    else:
        last_was_letter_flag = False
        current_word_length = 0

print(f"{max_length} {parenthesis_word_count}")
